components.label: Build pipeline (simulate_all + render_all + gate)
components.method: ordered declared stages: weather, thermal features, vegetation, land, river, foodweb, insects, fish, grazers, finalize; mapped finite-volume river cells provide the runtime temperature and discharge
components.notes: fresh build directories contain model outputs, conservation checks, dependency hashes, registries, and runtime sidecars

components.label: Transactional publish to Godot world
components.method: check completed build and consumer manifest; back up targets, copy completed artifacts, verify hashes, and write receipt; roll back copied targets on failure
components.notes: publishes river_replay.json, runtime world epoch, ecosystem, weather, declared sidecars and textures; leaves completed build artifacts unchanged

components.label: Run mode declaration and prescribed/predicted split
components.method: enum validation of run_mode plus list of prescribed/predicted quantities
components.notes: feeds BUILD.json manifest and validation checks

components.label: Scientific claim registry
components.method: static list of five claims each with required processes, calibration/evaluation dataset IDs, acceptance criteria; all review_status=not_yet_accepted
components.notes: two seed claims (reach temperature, snow SWE) have evidence artifacts; the three provider claims (discharge, groundwater, 2-D channel) have empty datasets

components.label: Component exchange contract
components.method: declared exchanges, conservation and physical-support checks; runtime reach summaries use the mapped river cells
components.notes: named exchanges: boundary_water, boundary_heat, lateral_water, lateral_heat, outlet_export, surface_newton, surface_budget, landscape_temperature, pocket_holding, snow_runoff_discharge, shear_disturbance; coupling_check.json records the verifier verdict per build

components.label: Governing equations inventory
components.method: static declaration of model level, equations, assumptions, limits per component
components.notes: governing equations, assumptions, units and evidence status for each declared component

components.label: Parameter class and evidence registry
components.method: per-knob record of param_class (observed, derived, literature, calibrated, assumed, illustrative, physical_constant), source references, applicability, uncertainty, missingness, review
components.notes: unknown uncertainty allowed; registry_errors cross-checks source references against config files

components.label: Hashes, build IDs, sidecars
components.method: SHA-256 hashing of inputs/code/config; build_id = short digest; write_sidecar adds parameter_provenance block
components.notes: every build artifact carries sources and params provenance block

components.label: Build gate (checks)
components.method: conservation (heat ledger), topology, provenance, determinism, run-mode split; folds coupling, cross-family and FiPy convergence checks; validation/claims.py gates reach and SNOTEL holdout rmse against null models; aggregates godot/apron/refuge/substrate/snow/grazer/replay-budget failures
components.notes: exit code 2 when any gate fails

components.label: Hydrology unit validation
components.method: optional pint registry; refuses bare or mixed-unit hydro fields

components.label: Single EPSG:32612 coordinate frame
components.method: central constants matched against prepare_world.py; unit converters fail on bare or mixed units

components.label: Merge Python fragments into schema-v1 ecosystem.json
components.method: copy baseline, overwrite river_reaches, inject weather keys, set clock_hour, attach patches2 and wildlife3; validate_for_godot gates schema
components.notes: sole published surface for river/weather/patches/wildlife; ecosystem.gd advances insect_activity, biomass, moisture off these records

components.label: Reproject PNG fields into midway_macro frame
components.method: stub placeholder, 9 lines
components.notes: declared responsibility; no implementation and not called by build

components.label: SQLite analysis store (per-build)
components.method: read-only queries over allow-listed tables and columns (census_trees, replay_cells, replay_frames, obs_usgs, obs_snotel, fits_reach, fits_snow, meta)
components.notes: operator runs tools/build_store.py after a build; neither build.py nor publish.py call it

components.label: HTTP backend for census analysis and proposal review
components.method: stdlib HTTP server exposing /api/snapshot, /api/density, /api/compare, /api/propose over analysis_store and provider stacks
components.notes: runs on demand (python3 -m yellowstone_python.llm_backend --serve); not touched by build/publish

components.label: study_mode A/B presets
components.method: allow-listed config overrides (air temperature, discharge, shade/cloud, thermal source); writes two ecosystem.json variants
components.notes: firehole_control.json / firehole_pulse.json are produced via study_mode runs or hot_lowflow tools and consumed by python_river_replay.gd; build.py does not call study_mode

components.label: Game-clock epoch parsing
components.method: ISO date to local-offset epoch converter

components.label: microclimate (air, wind, humidity, condensation)
components.method: sinusoidal diurnal air curve lagging 15:00; mean + stochastic wind trace with seed; Magnus-Tetens dewpoint; measured Open-Meteo bundle (if present) overrides authored defaults
components.notes: Python curve lags noon by 3 h; Godot ecosystem.gd uses noon-peaking curve, residual documented at build.py:359

components.label: Open-Meteo met forcing fetcher
components.method: stdlib urllib Open-Meteo hourly bundle (shortwave, air, humidity, wind) frozen to derived/met.json
components.notes: operator runs these fetchers; build.py loads whatever met.json exists

components.label: Explicit surface energy budget
components.method: shortwave, longwave, sensible, latent (W/m2) with scaled turbulent coefficients, linearized implicitly
components.notes: selected when replay.energy_budget flag or explicit meteorology bundle; otherwise Newton lumped exchange is used

components.label: Analytical six-reach reference
components.method: fully mixed reach equations for independent analytical comparison
components.notes: benchmark reference; runtime reaches are flow-weighted summaries of finite-volume replay cells

components.label: Mapped Firehole chain for the replay solver
components.method: map saved Midway Firehole to cells with chainage and cross-sections; feed river_transport solver
components.notes: maps replay cells to the saved world geometry; publishes river_replay.json to the world and preserves the study control/pulse pair

components.label: Conservative finite-volume river transport
components.method: finite-volume d(V T)/dt = Q(T_{i-1}-T_i) + D A (T_{i+1}-2T_i+T_{i-1})/dx + Phi_i with per-cell sources and Newton or explicit budget surface flux
components.notes: relative heat residual limit 1e-9 and relative water residual limit 1e-12; runtime and live river authority

components.label: Trapezoidal channel hydraulics diagnostics
components.method: V = Q/A on trapezoidal cross-section, Manning consistency ratio, Froude, Fischer longitudinal dispersion, bed shear
components.notes: diagnostic only; river_transport solver remains rectangular. bed_shear_pa feeds foodweb shear_disturbance

components.label: Hydraulic identifiability diagnostics
components.method: roughness, bank-slope, depth multi-start Manning-ratio cost; rank+max-cost reported
components.notes: records rank and surface-flux structural gap in CHECKS metrics

components.label: Numerical benchmarks for the replay solver
components.method: advection and dispersion benchmarks for the declared equation level (no momentum)

components.label: Reach-scale calibration and dispersion experiments
components.method: fit Newton h, dispersion, surface budget params against Firehole obs bundle
components.notes: operator-run (reach_heat_fit_v300k.json evidence artifact); not part of build

components.label: Reach fit uncertainty quantification
components.method: lumped-fit UQ + authored-knob sensitivity
components.notes: standalone CLI; evidence artifact reach_ensemble_uq_v300k.json

components.label: FiPy steady 1-D advection + Newton reference
components.method: FiPy reference compared against analytic profile
components.notes: optional dependency gated by importlib.util

components.label: Diagnostic replay figures
components.method: matplotlib Agg figures from frozen artifacts

components.label: Pandas obs-frame alignment for fits
components.method: DatetimeIndex resample-mean alignment; H(x) measurement operator over station chainage
components.notes: used by calibrate/uncertainty

components.label: Reference dataset split roles
components.method: calibration/development/locked-final split assignment
components.notes: declarative metadata

components.label: CF-style NetCDF export
components.method: CF export of temperature frames
components.notes: standalone utility

components.label: Steady 2-D thermal plume (Excelsior mixing zone)
components.method: u dT/dz = Dx d2T/dx2 + Dz d2T/dz2 - k(T-ambient) on 128x128 implicit upwind/centered grid
components.notes: plume_field.json drawn as a world-space temperature quad with legend

components.label: overland flow (rainfall/infiltration/runoff)
components.method: wraps hydrology/hydrosim.py local-inertial shallow-water solver (Bates et al. 2010) with Green-Ampt infiltration on block-mean terrain.f32; rain source is overland.rain_mm_h, then met_bundle precipitation_mm, then snow.precip_mm_d
components.notes: outlet runoff now reaches the river boundary; Godot shows a scene-wide tint from a scalar only, no per-cell field yet

components.label: Standalone shallow-water + soil model
components.method: Green-Ampt / Horton infiltration, local-inertial Bates shallow-water, Brooks-Corey drainage, FAO-56 ET, linear-reservoir groundwater
components.notes: self-validated against analytic + Newton bisection in validate_hydrosim.py; integrated into build only through overland_flow.run_overland; the Godot 3 plugin wrapper godot_hydro_node.py was removed (fixes-31 F9)

components.label: Cached hydrology service wrapper around hydrosim
components.method: snapshot(weather, hour) wrapper over hydrosim; returns ground_wetness_fraction and a status string; refuse_on_cfl_overflow=True yields status=refused_cfl_exceeded when hydrosim exceeds its CFL
components.notes: surfaced only through llm_backend HTTP server; the overland-runoff authority remains overland_flow in the build

components.label: Synthetic-catchment runoff discharge series
components.method: synthetic elevation + Green-Ampt predicts discharge series; optional landlab path
components.notes: claim upstream_discharge_predicted (not_yet_accepted); not called by build/publish

components.label: Synthetic MODFLOW RIV laterals
components.method: flopy-driven synthetic MF6 model; maps RIV package to replay Source dicts with lateral discharge + temperature
components.notes: claim groundwater_lateral_heat (not_yet_accepted); not called by build/publish

components.label: hydrothermal pool shells, rims, aprons
components.method: radial T(r)=T_edge+(T_c-T_edge)(1-(r/rw)^2); color ramp per RECIPE; apron buffered ring; exclusion test used by vegetation and grazer planners
components.notes: pool_shells.json and pool_ramps/*.png are shipped by publish.py

components.label: geochemistry / substrate rules / silica
components.method: siliceous Midway vs travertine Mammoth palette gate; silica solubility T-polynomials (quartz, chalcedony, amorphous) and saturation index per cell from the last replay frame
components.notes: silica saturation markers along the Firehole; geochemistry.json now carries chainage_m, x_m, z_m, overlay still spaces markers along the mainline

components.label: snowpack, soil water, phenology
components.method: degree-day melt = k_melt max(0, T-tbase) + thermal ground flux; soil bucket with ET and drainage; phenology stage from GDD and moisture
components.notes: produces snow_runoff_m3_s as a discharge increment added to boundary_m3s; geometry frozen so renderer applies snow via shader mask

components.label: Energy-balance snowmelt vs SNOTEL
components.method: SW_down = S_RAD * TOA(doi,lat) * cloud(dtr); melt = (1-albedo)*SW + C0 + C_T*TAVG
components.notes: replaces degree-day with energy budget; standalone validator against SNOTEL

components.label: SNOTEL validation of snow and soil water model
components.method: train/holdout split on SNOTEL WTEQ/PRCP/TAVG; k_melt grid fit; RMSE/bias/peak-timing against persistence and no-melt nulls
components.notes: claim snow_swe_clearings evidence; standalone operator CLI

components.label: patch biomass, suitability, plantings
components.method: logistic biomass with light/water factors and grazing loss; proposals pass thermal exclusion, slope, suitability, pair-separation gates
components.notes: patch_state.json sidecar is diagnostic; the live patches reach Godot via ecosystem.variant.patches

components.label: Canopy census tree detector
components.method: NAIP tree detection with QA self-check; blind SRS plot validation with Hungarian matching; crown-area canopy fraction fed to the planting-proposal reviewer
components.notes: census crowns drawn on the map view; canopy also drives vegetation suitability

components.label: Flora density generator and machine-review
components.method: regional seeded point sets passed through review (slope, thermal exclusion, suitability, pairwise separation)
components.notes: writes placement_overrides.json manually; not called by build

components.label: Foot trail mask bake
components.method: paint trail polylines into a 2048x2048 world-extent mask with core + soft shoulder for the terrain shader
components.notes: operator bake, consumed by Godot terrain shader; not called by build.py

components.label: insect activity, compartments, bird intake
components.method: activity = sun*wind*cloud*moisture*flowering gates; Holling type II prey intake; compartments Nt (terrestrial), Nb (benthic), Ne (emergent) with degree-day emergence
components.notes: activity is published via ecosystem.variant.patches[].insect_activity and wildlife durations

components.label: trout suitability, refuge, chainage placement
components.method: suitability-weighted score Ui = wf Fi + wc Ci - wt phi(Ti) - wv Vi - wd Di; refuge chosen as argmax within swim range; chainage-window hold placement
components.notes: trout wildlife records merged into ecosystem.variant; fish.json sidecar + refuge_map.png are diagnostic (not published)

components.label: Trout thermal response fits
components.method: species-specific split-Gaussian / logistic curves fitted via scipy least_squares to literature anchors
components.notes: aquatic/fish.py uses THERMAL_SPECIES lookup; thermal_curves fits are standalone

components.label: 14-day insect/trout/dipper food web on replay thermal landscape
components.method: time-mean thermal landscape -> per-cell suitability + Holling II prey splits among trout and dipper, with benthic degree-day emergence; bed-shear ramp disturbs benthic stock
components.notes: aquatic_foodweb.json sidecar not read by Godot; refuge chainage and dipper intake flow into wildlife records in ecosystem.variant

components.label: grazer plan-paths and route validation
components.method: Euclidean-heuristic shortest path with per-cell block tests; grazing timings from biomass vs capacity
components.notes: grazer.json sidecar not read by Godot; wildlife path_xz travels through ecosystem.variant

components.label: A/B scenario endpoint comparison
components.method: reads two derived/<build-id> dirs and reports deltas (temperatures, flows, trout holds, insect activity, snow, phenology, heat budget)
components.notes: endpoint deltas only; exposure-duration metrics flagged for later phase

components.label: Hot low-flow scenarios
components.method: mainstem, authored tributary pockets, or measured tributaries using a shared replay setup; measured inputs are required for the measured subcommand
components.notes: preserves solver cell ids; scenario outputs declare forcing and evidence classes

components.label: Firehole obs bundle fetcher
components.method: stdlib urllib fetch of USGS Water Services + Open-Meteo for Firehole gauges and tributary candidates; writes frozen bundles for the calibrate/validate paths
components.notes: evidence for claim reach_water_temperature_ice_free

components.label: SNOTEL obs bundle fetcher
components.method: fetch daily WTEQ, PRCP, SNWD, TAVG/TMAX/TMIN for configured SNOTEL sites
components.notes: feeds land/snow_validate.py

components.label: Observation bundle gate
components.method: schema/continuity/coverage checks and old-vs-refetch drift detection

components.label: Channel cross-section geometry derivation
components.method: USGS NWIS field measurements + 3DEP DEM used to build trapezoidal cross-section profiles consumed by replay.hydraulics

components.label: Provenance audit over derived/
components.method: mechanical check of status strings against measured vocabulary; Pillow-only diagnostic PNGs; stdlib notebook smoke executor

components.label: Calibration summary sidecar for Godot
components.method: pack the champion reach-heat fit scalars (q_lat, t_lat, c_mult, train/holdout rmse and bias, budget_ok) with the first gauge site's discharge-temperature trace
components.notes: reach fit and gauge trace drawn in the calibration panel
